skill.name: project-map-builder
skill.description: Creates or updates PROJECT_MAP.md files for user-selected folders. The skill asks for scope before scanning, supports one or more directories, and favors incremental updates when a map already exists.
skill.summary: Builds scoped PROJECT_MAP.md documentation for selected folders and updates existing maps incrementally.
skill.author: yunshu0909

content.user_title: Build Project Maps for Selected Folders
content.value_statement: Large repositories are hard to understand when folder roles are undocumented. This skill creates or updates PROJECT_MAP.md files for selected folders with concise structure and context.
actual_capabilities: Asks the user to define scan scope before reading files.
Builds a PROJECT_MAP.md structure for one selected directory.
Supports merged or separate maps for multiple directories.
Updates existing PROJECT_MAP.md files with incremental changes.
Lists files quickly and reads only key files for context.
Marks assumptions and unconfirmed behavior in the document.
limitations: It requires the user to provide folder scope before work begins.
It does not perform full repository scans by default.
It may miss details outside the selected folders.
It depends on available file listing tools in the workspace.

use_cases.title: Document a Feature Area
use_cases.description: Create a map for one feature folder before making changes.

use_cases.title: Onboard to a Repository
use_cases.description: Produce a concise folder guide for teammates joining a project.

use_cases.title: Refresh Existing Project Notes
use_cases.description: Update PROJECT_MAP.md after files are added, removed, or reorganized.

prompt_templates.title: Map One Folder
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-map-builder to create PROJECT_MAP.md for [folder]. Ask me before scanning anything outside that folder.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a focused directory map.

prompt_templates.title: Update Existing Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the existing PROJECT_MAP.md in [folder]. Only scan [folder] and add a dated update section.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Multiple Folders
prompt_templates.prompt: Build project maps for [folder A] and [folder B]. Ask whether I want one merged document or separate documents.
prompt_templates.scenario: Document related areas without scanning the full repository.

prompt_templates.title: Map Architecture Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PROJECT_MAP.md for [folder] that emphasizes entry points, configuration, storage, tests, module relationships, risks, and unknowns.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a richer architecture overview.

output_examples.input: Create a project map for the src/auth folder.
output_examples.output: The skill confirms src/auth as the scope, lists files, reads key entry points, and writes PROJECT_MAP.md in src/auth.

output_examples.input: Update the map for packages/ui after a component cleanup.
output_examples.output: The skill reads the existing PROJECT_MAP.md, scans only packages/ui, updates changed sections, and adds a dated cleanup summary.

output_examples.input: Map api and worker folders separately.
output_examples.output: The skill asks whether to merge or split maps, then creates one PROJECT_MAP.md in each selected folder after confirmation.

best_practices: Start with one folder or a small set of related folders.
Confirm whether multiple folders should share one map or separate maps.
Review assumptions and unknowns before treating the map as complete.
anti_patterns: Do not request a full repository scan when a focused folder map is enough.
Do not use the map as a substitute for reading critical source files.
Do not overwrite existing PROJECT_MAP.md content without checking changes.

faq.question: Does this skill scan the whole repository by default?
faq.answer: No. It must ask for a folder scope first and should avoid full repository scans.

faq.question: Where does it write PROJECT_MAP.md?
faq.answer: For one folder, it writes the file in that folder. For multiple folders, it asks how to organize output.

faq.question: Can it update an existing map?
faq.answer: Yes. It reads the existing file and makes incremental updates based on the selected scope.

faq.question: Does it read every source file?
faq.answer: No. It lists files, then opens only key files needed to explain structure and relationships.

faq.question: Can it handle multiple directories?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create one merged map or separate maps after user confirmation.

faq.question: What should I review after generation?
faq.answer: Check assumptions, unconfirmed areas, entry points, and risk notes before relying on the map.
